steadyPrecession.vectorInsight: Gravity pulls down — but τ = dL/dt is ⊥ L, so the tip moves sideways.
steadyPrecession.noTorqueMessage: Pivot at center of mass: τ = 0, no precession.
steadyPrecession.formulaHint: Ω = τ / (I ω)  —  faster spin → slower precession

nutation.sceneTitle: Heavy top — path traced by the axle tip
nutation.releaseSteady: At the steady rate — no wobble
nutation.belowCritical: Spin is below the critical value — no steady precession exists at this tilt, so the top must nutate.
nutation.insight: Real tops are released, not handed the answer: the axis dips, picks up precession, and rises again.

torqueFree.placeholder: Torque-free tumbling — asymmetric rigid body via Euler's equations. Coming soon.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a spinning gyroscope on a pivoted axle, a live vector diagram of weight, torque, angular momentum, and precession, and a graph of precession angle versus time.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you change spin rate, arm mass, pivot distance, and whether the pivot is at the center of mass. Numeric readouts compare measured and predicted precession rates.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Adjust the spin rate and arm mass, then watch how the precession rate responds. Toggle pivot at center of mass to see precession stop.

steadyPrecession.currentDetailsPattern: Predicted precession rate is {{predictedHz}} hertz. Measured slope is {{measuredHz}} hertz.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a heavy top pivoted at its base, the path traced by its axle tip, the two circles bounding the nutation band, and a graph of the tilt angle versus time.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area lets you set the spin rate and release tilt, choose how the top is released, turn friction on or off, and release the top again. Readouts give the nutation band, nutation and precession frequencies, and the critical spin.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Release the top from rest to see cusps, then try pushing it backward or forward and compare the traced paths.

nutation.currentDetailsPattern: The axle is tilted {{tilt}} degrees from vertical, nutating between {{thetaMin}} and {{thetaMax}} degrees. Mean precession is {{precessionHz}} hertz and nutation is {{nutationHz}} hertz.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area will show a torque-free asymmetric rigid body tumbling in space, with the Poinsot construction on the inertia ellipsoid.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls for initial spin axis and moment-of-inertia ratios will appear here.
